content: When rendering issue badges in seeds, formatters must receive a closedBlockerIds set. Compute once per command: const closedBlockerIds = new Set(allIssues.filter(i => i.status === 'closed').map(i => i.id)). Pass to formatIssueOneLine, formatIssueOneLineCompact, printIssueOneLine. Without the set, issues whose blockers have all been closed still render with [blocked] tag. Call sites: src/commands/{list,ready,blocked,show,search,dep,tpl}.ts.

When porting the L5 governance baseline (.github/) into a sub-repo from templates/l5-toolkit/github/: issue templates use a <cli> placeholder that must be replaced with the repo's binary name (sd for seeds), and ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml's discussions URL must point at the per-repo GitHub (https://github.com/jayminwest/seeds/discussions), not the os-eco meta-repo. dependabot.yml and pull_request_template.md copy verbatim (already neutral). Do not touch pre-existing .github/workflows/.

name: l5-config-port-adapt-to-baseline
description: Porting L5 toolkit lint/dup/dep configs into a sub-repo with existing code: biome's noExcessiveCognitiveComplexity (cap 15) flags pre-existing command/parser functions — list offenders in a biome overrides[] block with the rule 'off' (mirrors canopy) so the cap governs new code without a refactor (commit guidance forbids source changes in scaffolding). jscpd threshold is adapted to current state: seeds baseline was 3.46%, so threshold=4 (not the ideal 3%) per porting-playbook 'adapt budgets/thresholds to current state'; ratchet-to-3% is a separate seed. knip: seeds tsconfig uses types:['bun-types'] (transitive via @types/bun) which knip reports as Unresolved — fix in knip.json with ignoreUnresolved:['bun-types'] rather than editing tsconfig (tsconfig edits are out of scope). extensions/**/*.ts entry+project globs match nothing today and emit non-fatal knip configuration hints; that is the intended future-proof tolerance, not an error. bunfig.toml: omit [test] root so bun's recursive discovery covers both src/ and extensions/.

name: l5-ratchet-port-colocated-budgets
description: Porting L5 toolkit ratchet scripts (check-file-sizes/check-debt-markers) into seeds with budgets co-located in scripts/ (not toolkit's ../budgets/ default): keep scripts verbatim (no logic change) and pass --budget scripts/<file>.json in the package.json check:size/check:debt entries. Adapt colocated *.test.ts: replace TOOLKIT_ROOT=resolve(import.meta.dir,'..') with SCRIPT_DIR=import.meta.dir, and point the CLI spawn + well-formed-budget reads at resolve(SCRIPT_DIR,'<file>'). The verbatim scripts trip biome noExcessiveCognitiveComplexity (scan() at 22/30 vs cap 15) so grandfather both into the existing biome.json complexity-off override rather than refactoring. Baseline file-size at threshold 500 with per-file budgets ceil(lines/50)*50+50 for the 5 files over 500; debt tracker prefixes sd-/seeds-/mx- as a hex regex plus #NNN and URL.

name: l5-coverage-reporters-port
description: Porting L5 coverage+reporters into seeds: ship toolkit check-coverage.ts verbatim (it has --budget/--repo-root flags) and point package.json at the co-located scripts/coverage-budgets.json via --budget, exactly like check:size/check:debt. Use canopy's report-test-timing.ts (default junit.xml at repo root, matching test:ci --reporter-outfile=junit.xml) rather than the toolkit default test-results/junit.xml. report-quality-metrics.ts needs its three budget reads repointed budgets/->scripts/ since seeds co-locates budgets. test:ci is self-contained (--coverage-reporter=text+lcov --coverage-dir=coverage --reporter=junit --reporter-outfile=junit.xml), avoiding a bunfig [test] change. Budget shape is toolkit {functions,lines,packages} percentages in [0,100], floored down from observed (88.43/80.96 -> 87/80).

name: l5-agents-md-validator-port
description: Porting validate-agents-md.ts from l5-toolkit into seeds: the script trips seeds' biome noExcessiveCognitiveComplexity (max 15) on extractBacktickedPaths(23) and validate(19), same as the ratchet scripts — add scripts/validate-agents-md.ts to the biome.json overrides list that disables the rule (alongside check-file-sizes/check-debt-markers), don't refactor the verbatim toolkit source. AGENTS.md backticked paths are validated relative to repo root, so qualify bare module names (src/store.ts not store.ts); tokens with spaces/<>/= or trailing ... are skipped. check:agents only targets AGENTS.md by default, so RUNBOOK.md/SKILL.md paths aren't validated. Run lint:fix after copying the toolkit test (import-sort + format drift).

name: l5-pino-logger-and-governance-port
description: Porting L5 pino logging + governance into seeds: pino+pino-pretty go in devDependencies (seeds is a Bun-direct CLI, no bundle); src/log.ts exports createLog(options) + a default 'log' instance, resolving level INSIDE the factory (SEEDS_LOG_LEVEL > SEEDS_DEBUG===1 ? debug : info) so tests override via env+re-create. redact uses {paths,remove:true} with bare + '*.' one-level-nested keys (password/token/apiKey/secret/authorization) + headers.cookie/authorization, mirroring burrow. Seeds has NO ad-hoc debug output — all console.* is user-facing output.ts — so the only honest 'route through pino' point is index.ts's top-level catch, lazy-importing log and calling log.debug({err,cmd}) (silent at info, no happy-path logger cost). pino-pretty is referenced only as a transport string so add it to knip ignoreDependencies. pre-commit hook (toolkit version = lint+typecheck only, sub-2s) installed via prepare script: '[ -e .git ] && git config core.hooksPath scripts/hooks || true'.

name: l5-milestone-seal-port
description: Final L5 seal for seeds (seeds-317e): wire check:all aggregator into package.json (check:size && check:debt && check:dups && check:deps && check:agents && check:coverage — NO check:bundle-size since seeds is unbundled) and extend .github/workflows/ci.yml in place (lint, typecheck, check:all, test:ci, report:test-timing/report:quality piped to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY, upload junit.xml + coverage/lcov.info artifacts). seeds writes junit.xml to repo root (not test-results/ like the toolkit) — keep CI artifact paths in sync with the test:ci --reporter-outfile. junit.xml + coverage/ are gitignored; commit ONLY package.json + ci.yml. Do NOT run sd sync (mixes mission .seeds/ tracking into L5 history). All four gates exit 0 without loosening budgets: coverage funcs 88.45%/floor 87, lines 81.07%/floor 80.

sd doctor's gitattributes check/fix (src/commands/doctor.ts checkGitattributes + fixGitattributes) hardcoded only issues.jsonl + templates.jsonl merge=union lines, while sd init (init.ts MERGE_UNION_LINES) was updated to also write plans.jsonl. The two lists drifted, so doctor reported healthy and 'doctor --fix' never backfilled plans.jsonl — projects whose .gitattributes predated plans support got real git merge conflicts on plans.jsonl.
resolution: Exported MERGE_UNION_LINES from init.ts and made doctor's checkGitattributes + fixGitattributes loop over the shared constant for both detection and repair. Lesson: when one site writes a config list, the validator/repair site must consume the SAME constant, not a copy.

description: sync.test.ts git-failure flake: clearing GIT_AUTHOR_*/HOME to force a commit failure is unreliable. Bun drops empty-string env vars when inheriting process.env (so the in-process spawn never sees them cleared), and git still auto-derives an OS identity (username@hostname via gecos) unless invoked with '-c user.useConfigOnly=true' — env-injected (GIT_CONFIG_COUNT) or config-file useConfigOnly does NOT disable gecos, only the -c flag does.
resolution: Install a pre-commit hook that exits 1 in the broken test repo, pinned via repo-local 'git config core.hooksPath', so git commit fails deterministically regardless of host identity. Drop all GIT_* env manipulation from both git-failure tests.

description: check:debt flags the word TODO in user-facing strings (e.g. prime text) as an untracked debt marker
resolution: Reword the string rather than allowlisting it.

content: Do not run sd onboard / sd setup inside a git worktree to update repo files: findSeedsDir resolves to the main checkout. Use sd onboard --stdout and splice the output in.

store.ts tracks malformed-line counts per JSONL file on each read; writeIssues/writePlans/writeTemplates throw 'Refusing to rewrite ... malformed line(s) would be lost' if the last read skipped rows. Any new rewrite path must read the file (under the lock) before writing, or the guard cannot see the corruption.

description: sd CLI values beginning with '--' are silently swallowed by the commander→argv→parseArgs round-trip: sd create --title '--json ...' fails, sd update X --title '--x' no-ops, sd close X --reason '--json' drops the reason.
resolution: Avoid starting sd titles/reasons/descriptions with '--' until seeds-0374 removes the round-trip.

description: sd doctor 'bidirectional mismatch' warnings fire on every closed blocker (close strips dependents' blockedBy but keeps blocks; 190 in seeds' own store).
resolution: Treat as noise; never run sd doctor --fix to clear them because fixBidirectional re-adds closed blockers. Readiness derives from closed ids. Tracked seeds-3f8d/seeds-9be5.

description: Plan step.blocks became 1-based in seeds a13b9543 (seeds-185f) but warren planner/nightwatch/bugwatch prompts still say 0-based, so agents get contradictory instructions.
resolution: When changing a plan-submit wire format, grep warren src/registry/builtins and prompt-fragments and update them in the same change.

description: sd sync runs git add .seeds/ then a bare git commit, so it also commits anything else already staged (seeds-6b8d).
resolution: Never run sd sync with unrelated staged changes; commit .seeds/ by path (git commit -- .seeds/) until fixed.

content: Every JSONL rewrite path must read the file under the lock before writing, because store.ts only refuses to drop malformed rows when the preceding read saw them (malformedOnLastRead guard, seeds-b52d); a blind write bypasses the guard.

sd guard checks MCP tools only if the PreToolUse matcher in setup.ts lets them through; a new guarded tool class needs guard.ts pathKeys + setup.ts matcher + the INSTALLED fixture in setup.test.ts updated together

title: sd close keeps blockedBy edges
rationale: stripping on write caused cross-branch JSONL conflicts, desynced blocks/blockedBy for doctor, and lost deps on reopen

content: src/yaml.ts quote scanners (findKeyColon/stripComment/splitFlow) must skip backslash escapes inside double quotes because the emitter writes quoted keys/values via JSON.stringify; when changing the emitter, always cross-check round-trips against the yaml devDependency (parseStdYaml) as yaml.test.ts does

plan_step_index is a 0-based index into plan.sections.steps (the blueprint), never a position in plan.children — reorder/adopt --at change children order without invalidating it; multiple children may share an index (adopt --step); requires_plan children carry plan_step_index but no plan_id, so resolve plan membership via plan.children, not plan_id
scripts/file-size-budgets.json freezes src/commands/plan.ts near its current size; avoid raising the budget — make plan.ts changes net-neutral by refactoring nearby duplication

Under --json, CommanderErrors reach handleTopLevelError only because index.ts calls routeCommanderErrors(program) after registerAll; never register commands after that call or on a separately built Program, because they won't get exitOverride and will print plain-text errors
Prefer outputFailure (src/output.ts) for non-throwing failures that set exitCode=1; avoid bare process.stderr.write + exitCode because it bypasses the --json envelope

description: plan.ts and plan.test.ts sit at their frozen check:size budgets; any growth fails the gate
resolution: put new helpers in a sibling module (e.g. src/plan-failures.ts) and new tests in a separate plan-*.test.ts file

content: sd sync pathspecs come from syncPaths() in sync.ts; always add new tracked paths there so status, dry-run and add stay in step
Tests needing a non-git dir must set GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES to the mkdtemp root, because the OS tmpdir may sit inside a git repo

Lock files hold JSON {pid,host,startedAt}; isLockStale(lock, st) in store.ts is the single staleness rule (mtime >30s, or same-host owner pid dead) — never re-implement mtime-only checks elsewhere (e.g. doctor), call isLockStale
seeds-dd20

sd list machine formats (json, ids) are uncapped by default because consumers like warren treat them as the complete set; human formats cap at 50 and must print 'N of M shown' when truncating; --limit 0 means no limit
Avoid a commander .option() default when the default depends on mode: commander always passes the default to run(), so run() cannot tell explicit from default — apply the default inside run() instead

title: cycle detection counts closed issues
rationale: close keeps blockedBy edges, so a cycle through a closed issue deadlocks once reopened

content: Plan parent seeds are never auto-closed when their plan reaches done; reuse openParentsOfDonePlans in src/plan-lifecycle.ts for any 'done plan, open parent' logic instead of writing another scan

description: chalk 5's bundled supports-color ignores NO_COLOR (reads only FORCE_COLOR/--no-color), so under a PTY chalk.level stays 3; piped-stdout subprocess tests never catch it because color is already off
resolution: gate chalk.level via noColorRequested() in output.ts; verify under a PTY with: script -q /dev/null sd list

content: Duplicate ids in seeds JSONL: same createdAt means the same item re-edited (safe to collapse, last wins); different createdAt means two items collided on id and both must be kept — always use findIdCollisions/dedupKey from src/id-collisions.ts rather than plain id dedup

description: Tightening id-length regexes to {6} broke list-limit.test.ts, whose fixtures hand-seed 4-hex ids
resolution: only change regexes that match ids from generateId; leave hand-seeded fixture regexes at {4}

content: knip production mode needs '!' on the project glob (src/**/*.ts!); without it knip --production drops src from analysis and reports bogus unused deps (e.g. ajv)

description: A withLock test with a synchronous body passes even without any lock, because microtasks never interleave
resolution: hold the critical section across an await (read, await setTimeout, write) and assert maxInside===1

content: Commander actions pass their opts object straight to a typed run<Name>(…, opts, seedsDir?) handler; never re-serialise opts into argv, because the hand-rolled parse dropped --prefixed values and empty strings

test-harness runCli calls mod.run(args) only when a module exports run, else drives it via register(); always mirror new global root flags from index.ts in the harness program, because otherwise 'sd <cmd> -q' fails in tests

Merge strategy for .seeds/*.jsonl lives only in src/merge-strategy.ts (inspect/ensure); init and doctor are thin callers. Never substring-match .gitattributes — check what git resolves via git check-attr so custom drivers are accepted
A new sd command must be registered in both src/register-all.ts and the loaders map in src/test-harness.ts, because otherwise runCli throws 'unknown command' in tests

description: merge=union on .seeds JSONL stores that are rewritten in place yields silent duplicate rows and resurrects satisfied blockers
resolution: use merge=seeds-jsonl (sd merge-driver), a 3-way merge keyed by id; register via sd init / sd doctor --fix

content: --json 'command' is the space-joined subcommand path (e.g. 'tpl step add'); error envelopes derive it via resolveCommandPath in error-handler.ts so it matches success. Always use the full path in outputJson for new commands and add a case to src/json-contract.test.ts

--json envelope keys mirror the stored record they describe (Issue camelCase, plan refs snake_case like plan_id); add keys, never rename, because warren/overstory read them — src/json-contract.test.ts pins consumer-read keys

name: doctor-locked-rewrite
description: sd doctor --fix must rewrite stores via rewriteJsonl() in src/doctor-store.ts (withLock + temp+rename, optional .bak), never writeFileSync; fixers mutate RawLine.parsed in place and return serializeLines(lines) or null so untouched and malformed rows are preserved

content: Doctor file loops use JSONL_FILES (issues, templates, plans) from src/doctor-store.ts and lock checks include config.yaml.lock; always add new stores there, never as inline file arrays, so every check covers them

Issue row validity has one source of truth, validateIssue() in src/issue-schema.ts (store read/write, doctor, migrate, tpl pour); extend it there, never inline in doctor. Store quarantines invalid rows on read (hidden, warned once) and writes them back on rewrite; unparseable lines instead make rewrites refuse
Test harness: runCliJson throws on nonzero exit, so for doctor runs expected to fail use runCli and JSON.parse(stdout); migrate-from-beads is registered as 'migrate' in the loaders map

Bun's module-resolution failure (ResolveMessage, code ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND) is not an Error instance — read code/message field by field; a static import failure can only be caught via dynamic import() in a wrapper module like src/bin.ts

name: group-unknown-subcommand
description: A commander group with its own .action (sd plan) reports 'too many arguments' for an unknown subcommand; fix with allowExcessArguments() + cmd.error(unknownSubcommandMessage(...)) inside the action
Bun.spawnSync does not see process.env changes made after startup unless env: process.env is passed explicitly, so tests setting GIT_DIR etc. silently have no effect
resolution: pass env: process.env to spawnSync wherever env overrides matter

content: Add new sd commands in exactly one place: an entry in COMMAND_LOADERS (src/register-all.ts) whose key equals the commander name, because index.ts lazily loads only that module and test-harness uses the same map; register-all.test.ts enforces it

Store appends (appendIssue/Template/Plan) go through appendJsonlRow with O_APPEND under the caller's lock and never rewrite the file, so malformed and quarantined rows survive; only full rewrites pass through assertNoMalformedLoss

name: doctor-store-snapshot
description: doctor checks take a StoreSnapshot (readSnapshot in doctor-store.ts), not seedsDir: add new row checks as functions of snap.lines[file]/snap.issues/snap.invalid and list them in runStoreChecks so no check re-reads the file

name: id-index-maps
description: For id lookups inside loops use indexById/mapById from src/id-index.ts; positions stay valid only while rows are replaced in place, so rebuild the index after push/splice/filter
